$comment: THE WORLD INDEX — every placed thing on the island, in one file.
Move a monument by editing lat/long/facingDeg here; the scene, the
blockers, the minimap, and docs/world-map.md all follow.
lat: 90 = the pole (spawn). Lower = further out toward the water.
grass ends ~66, sand runs ~24 down to the waterline ~15.
long: 0 = the sunset side (sun, dock), 180 = the night side (campfire).
facingDeg: 0 faces local NORTH (uphill, toward the pole); 90 faces east.
liftM: extra height above the ground, for things standing on furniture.
Adding one: give it an id, and wire the id where the scene expects it.
Removing one: delete the entry and its consumer (tests name the ids).

monuments.label: Camera tripod — Photos
monuments.notes: On the dock's far end, over water, facing the sun.

monuments.label: Bulletin board — Papers
monuments.notes: Grass, sunset side; angled toward the walking approach.

monuments.label: Moai — About
monuments.notes: Dusk boundary west. Walk fully around it.

monuments.label: CRT TV on crate — Videos
monuments.notes: Sits on the crate; screen glow reads at night.

monuments.label: Rift portal — the build-log room
monuments.notes: Floats. Step through to the room; the room is not on this map.

monuments.label: Memorial garden — fenced plot
monuments.notes: Gate on the south (downhill) side. Interior fully walkable.

monuments.label: Dock
monuments.notes: Runs lat 24 → 13 down its meridian; DOCK in planetConfig holds the strip.

monuments.label: Koa the ukulele player
monuments.notes: Seat ON the dock's west edge; altitude derives from the deck strip.
